name: SlowBooks Cutover
tagline: Move one QuickBooks Desktop company to SlowBooks and prove the numbers
description: A guided migration for one company file, run through Conductor with the source held read-only. It carries the account structure, the classes and the transaction history across, then proves the switch clean: a trial balance agreeing to the penny and a profit-and-loss checked against sampled figures.
author: jschnett
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
